title: Fix double camera permission request on OS back and refactor qr scanner
body:
<!--
  Thanks for contributing!

  Provide a description of your changes below and a general summary in the title

  Please look at the following checklist to ensure that your PR can be accepted quickly:
-->

## Description

Moves scan qr logic to its own hook. Fix os back case on camera permission that caused to reopen the camera permission.

<!--
Describe what changed and why. Link the related issue: `Closes #NNN`
-->

## Type of Change

- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [x] 🛠️ Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ❌ Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [x] 🧹 Code refactor
- [ ] ✅ Build configuration change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation
- [ ] 🗑️ Chore
- [ ] 🧪 Tests

## How I Tested This

**Os back case before deny or approve** (on android)
- sign up
- go to start chat
- click on qr code icon
- Wait for camera permission request to be visible
- go back with os back
- Check that permission request doesn't appear again


**Denied case**
- sign up
- go to start chat
- click on qr code icon
- deny permision
- click go to settings
- give permission
- check that then the camera opens

Granted case
- sign up
- go to start chat
- click on qr code icon
- give permission
- check that then the camera opens
- scan an npub from other device
- Check that the profile is shown

title: Notification permission UX: in-app explainer before system prompt
body:
## Context
From PR #262 review — currently `requestPermission()` fires immediately on first login with no user context. On Android 13+, if the user denies, the system remembers the denial.

## Description
Add an in-app explanation screen/dialog before requesting the system notification permission. This should:
- Explain why notifications are needed (to receive messages when the app is backgrounded)
- Show before the first system permission prompt
- Not re-show if the user has already granted/denied
- Respect the notification account settings (#267)

## Additional UX
- The battery optimization exemption request (`REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS`) also needs user-facing explanation, since it triggers a system dialog
- Consider combining both into a single onboarding flow after first login

## Related
- PR #262 (local notifications)
- #265 (notification message improvements)
- #267 (notification navigation)
